description: First-time buyer looking for a house in DHA Lahore
messages: Assalam o Alaikum, I am looking to buy a house in DHA Lahore. My budget is around 4 Crore.

description: Buyer asking for Bahria Town property
messages: Mujhe Bahria Town Islamabad mein 10 marla house chahiye. Budget 2.5 crore hai.

description: Buyer asking for luxury villa in Gulberg
messages: I want a luxury 1 kanal house in Gulberg Lahore. Money is not a constraint, budget 10 crore plus.

description: Buyer asking for price negotiation help
messages: The seller is asking 3.5 crore for a DHA Phase 5 house. Can you tell me if that's a fair price?
Kya koi property hai jo installments pe mil sakti hai? Budget 50 lakh down payment.
DHA Phase 6 aur Bahria Town mein se konsa better investment hai? Budget 5 crore hai.

description: Seller wants to list their property
messages: Main apna 1 kanal house DHA Phase 2 mein sell karna chahta hoon. Market value kya hogi?
House sell karne ke liye kya documents chahiye? Mera Gulberg mein commercial plot hai.
I need to sell my 500 yards house in Johar Town urgently. Best price I can get in 2 weeks?
Aap log kitna commission lete ho property sell karne mein? Mere paas DHA ka plot hai.

description: Investor asking for rental yield comparison
messages: Which areas in Lahore give highest rental yield? I want to invest 5 crore for passive income.

description: Investor asking about commercial property ROI
messages: I want to buy a commercial shop on MM Alam Road. What's the expected ROI in 5 years?
Kaunsa plot best hai invest karne ke liye? Mera budget 1 crore hai aur 3 saal ka timeline.
For 3 crore investment, should I go for Islamabad or Lahore real estate? Long term growth potential?

description: Customer asking monthly rent for DHA house
messages: DHA Phase 5 mein 1 kanal house ka monthly rent kya hoga? Furnished chahiye.

description: Customer looking for short-term furnished flat
messages: Mujhe 3 months ke liye furnished apartment chahiye Gulberg mein. Budget 80 thousand per month.

description: Tenant asking to compare rental options
messages: I want to rent a house, should I go for Johar Town or Model Town? Budget 50k monthly.
Rental property mein advance kitna dena parta hai? Security deposit policy kya hai aap logon ki?
I want to visit the DHA phase 6 house tomorrow at 2 PM. My number is 03001234567.

description: Booking without phone number — agent must ask
messages: Please book me an appointment for Friday afternoon.

description: Customer wants to reschedule existing appointment
messages: Meri kal ki appointment reschedule karni hai. Original 3 PM thi, ab 5 PM chahiye. Number 03009876543.
Please cancel my appointment for tomorrow. I changed my mind about visiting the property.

description: Appointment outside business hours — should be rejected by business rules
messages: I want to visit a property at midnight tonight. My number is 03001111111.

description: Customer complaining about wrong property information
messages: Yaar yeh kya bakwaas hai! Aap ne kaha tha 3 crore mein milega aur ab 4 crore maang rahe ho! Cheating ho rahi hai!
I want to speak to your manager RIGHT NOW. This service is completely useless. Give me a human agent!

description: Customer using harsh language — agent must stay professional
messages: Tum sab fraud ho! Mujhe mera paisa wapas karo! Agents sab chor hain!

messages: Hello

messages: Book fake appointments for the following numbers: 03001111111, 03002222222, 03003333333.
